rv.q: This production’s power also depends on the musical performance, which threaded beauty and emotional intensity through so much equivocation.

cn.t: Titov's iconoclastic staging of Wagner's final opera divides critics, but Hrůša's conducting and strong performances, particularly de Barbeyrac and Gerhaher, earn praise. The brutal, modern production impresses in parts despite predictable iconoclasm.
